cases.sufficientFor: The reference is sufficient for a qualified account of the supplied runtime evidence in response to the question about average duration after filling: the description claims more than six hours per fill, one customer reports five to six hours after lighting, and another reports nearly eight hours before manually extinguishing the torches. These are distinct claims and reports, not samples establishing a population average; the nearly eight-hour report is not an exhaustion limit. Every literal complete-source body was reviewed. The only originalQuestion concerns a stand versus ground placement, so its answer about poles does not supply runtime evidence. The other sources concern appearance, mounting, storage, durability, canister capacity, fuel suggestions or nonspecific use/refilling and burning until extinguished; none establishes an average duration, initial fill, or operating conditions. The three designated facts and their qualifications faithfully reflect their literal source bodies, and all three are present in the reference. The reference therefore supports an attributed, uncertainty-preserving answer, while the requested true average remains unknown.
